import type { APIRoute } from 'astro';
import { site } from '@/shared/config/site';

export const GET: APIRoute = () => {
  const content = `
# ${site.name}

> ${site.description}

## Main Pages

- [Home](${site.domain}/)
- [Projects](${site.domain}/projects)
- [Sponsorship](${site.domain}/sponsor)
- [Contact](${site.domain}/sponsor/contact)

## Technical Stack

This site is built with Astro and Tailwind CSS, focusing on performance and clean design. It is deployed on Cloudflare Workers.
  `.trim();

  return new Response(content, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
    },
  });
};
